decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  (W1, ARC IP66 catalogue information, TC Cabinet Based Columns - Outline View Options and Accessories, Base and Windload Specification and Technical Specification received 14.09.10.)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The proposed lights shall be positioned to avoid any unreasonable harm to neighbouring residents as a result of the associated illumination.
Condition : 5 - The proposed columns shall be positioned to avoid obstruction to people using the public footpath.
description: Replacement of 5 Lighting Columns with new columns that have lights and CCTV cameras attached.  Removal of 9 obsolete CCTV columns and installation of 12 New CCTV columns.
